description: Hi, I'm Mohamed! Passionate about Python, tech, and cybersecurity. I'm currently building 'Moon Storytelling' for the NASA Space Apps Challenge—combining AI, 3D lunar modules, and interactive history. Let's build the future together!"
summary: LEFT BEHIND is an interactive, bilingual (English/Arabic) website about the spacecraft and hardware humans have left behind on the Moon, on Mars and in deep space. It turns 15 hardware records from 14 missions, based on NASA’s official mission pages and NSSDC records, into 3D models that visitors can rotate, take apart with Explode View, and watch in short event simulations. A voice narrator explains each record, a Telemetry Matrix compares them in one table, and the Mission Academy quiz (eight questions with points and a leaderboard) lets visitors test what they learned. Every record has a clear status label and a link to its official source. The page is built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Three.js (WebGL), GLSL shaders and SVG, with Manus and Claude used as AI assistants. It is an independent educational project, not affiliated with NASA, and its 3D models are illustrations generated in code.
details:
Summary
LEFT BEHIND is an interactive, bilingual (English/Arabic) web experience about spacecraft and hardware that were left behind on the Moon, on Mars and in deep space. It turns 15 hardware records from 14 missions into 3D models that visitors can explore, instead of a list of facts to read.

What It Does

  • Shows each record as a procedural 3D model that can be rotated in Inspect mode and taken apart with Explode View.
  • Plays a short event simulation for each record and a “Then vs. Now” timeline.
  • Offers a voice narrator for each record.
  • Includes the Mission Academy, a quiz of eight questions drawn from the records, with points and a leaderboard.
  • Provides a Telemetry Matrix that compares all records in one table, and a source directory linking to the official NASA pages.
  • Works fully in Arabic (right-to-left) and English.

How We Handled the Information
Each record separates the mission, the spacecraft and the surviving component. It uses five status labels, shows both values when official sources disagree, and labels artist concepts as illustrations and archival photographs as photographs. The narrator never claims to be an astronaut, engineer or witness.

Development Tools
HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6, no framework), Three.js r128 (WebGL), GLSL shaders, SVG, and the Web Speech, Web Audio and browser storage APIs. Manus and Claude were used as AI assistants during development, supporting planning, content writing and building the page.

Important Note
LEFT BEHIND is an independent educational project. It is not endorsed by, affiliated with, or operated by NASA. The 3D models are procedural illustrations generated in code, not NASA imagery, and they are not to scale.
